evidence.summary: pay(gateway, order, key=None) calls gateway.charge(order['amount'], key or str(id(order))), stores the returned charge_id on the order and sets paid=True.
When no key is passed the idempotency key falls back to str(id(order)), a per-process object address, so it is not stable across retries from another process or after a restart.
on_webhook(order, event) sets paid=True on every delivery; the event id and type are never read (source comment: 'every delivery applies again').
There is no try/except: if gateway.charge raises (for example a timeout after the charge went through) the order keeps no charge_id and is not marked paid.
The user describes Billfold as charging cards through a payment gateway and receiving its webhooks.

database: none: orders are in-memory dicts passed in by the caller

architecture.backend: A single module of free functions that mutate an order dict passed in by the caller; no persistence, no web layer.

features.name: Charge an order through the payment gateway
features.description: Charges an order's amount through a gateway object and records the returned charge id on the order.
features.observed_behaviour: pay() calls gateway.charge(amount, key), sets order['charge_id'] to the result and order['paid']=True. The idempotency key is the caller's key or str(id(order)).
features.business_logic: Idempotency is delegated to the gateway via the key; the fallback key is not stable. No check that the order is unpaid before charging. No handling of gateway errors or timeouts.
features.integration: Needs a gateway exposing charge(amount, key) -> charge_id.

features.name: Receive payment gateway webhooks
features.description: Applies a gateway webhook event to an order by marking it paid.
features.observed_behaviour: on_webhook(order, event) sets order['paid']=True unconditionally on every delivery.
features.business_logic: No de-duplication by event id, no event-type dispatch (refund events would also mark the order paid), no state check.
features.integration: Needs the gateway to deliver events; needs an order lookup by the caller.

integrations.name: Payment gateway
integrations.purpose: charge(amount, key) returns a charge id; delivers webhook events

error_handling.behaviour: exception propagates; order unchanged even if the gateway charged
applied again (idempotent only by accident because it sets the same flag)

unknowns: Webhook event schema: the code never reads the event, so its fields are only known from task.md (id, type, order_id, charge_id).
Currency and units of order['amount'] are not stated in the code; task.md uses amount_cents.
